# NXT Level Builds — Web Design & Digital Marketing
# Daytona Beach, FL | Serving Volusia County

## About
NXT Level Builds is a web design and digital marketing agency based in Daytona Beach, Florida. We build custom websites, manage Google Ads, run local SEO campaigns, and build AI automation systems for local service businesses.

## Service Areas
Daytona Beach, Port Orange, Ormond Beach, New Smyrna Beach, DeLand, Palm Coast — and all of Volusia County, Florida.

## Services
- Custom Web Design: High-converting, mobile-first websites built for speed and SEO. Simple sites from $599 with $150/mo growth plan.
- Local SEO: On-page optimization, Google Business Profile management, local citation building. $497/mo.
- Google Ads Management: Search, LSA, and Display campaigns built for ROI. $497/mo + ad spend, custom campaigns quoted individually.
- AI Automation: CRM integration, AI chatbots, workflow automation. Starting at $1,497.
